# Synthetic image corpus

Thirty fixed images: fifteen vendor-mark examples, ten clean controls and five unknown-text-mark controls. No user uploads or third-party photographs are included.

The supported examples were generated by `scripts/render_visible_examples.py` from upstream `wiltodelta/remove-ai-watermarks` commit `b57ef6045cd7de525bc10546d4c1ce9f9fe151f7`. The renderer's SHA-256 and each fixture hash are in `manifest.json`. Its source and embedded templates are covered by the upstream Apache-2.0 license at `remove-ai-watermarks/LICENSE`. Clean and unsupported examples use that renderer's deterministic base-image function with fixed seeds and simple Pillow shapes/text.

Jimeng's top-left pill is a documented missed example without provider provenance. It stays in the corpus as an explicit allowed miss; additional misses fail verification. These synthetic regression cases do not establish real-world accuracy or hidden-watermark removal.
